pairs.difference: A shows the whole police car standing in the middle of a street scene, with a house, a row of bushes, clouds and a kerb all in the background. pairs.fix: Close-up on the police car parked on an asphalt road with lane markings, the car fills the card and is cut off by the right edge, plain blue sky behind, no houses, bushes or other scenery.

pairs.fix: Book lying on a plain light wooden tabletop with soft, low-contrast grain, seen from above, the surface fills the card.

pairs.difference: Behind B's sneakers, a hard horizontal line splits an orange wall from a cream floor of a different color, so this is neither a plain floor in the backdrop's color nor a real material. A's hat sits on a seamless purple sweep, which is category 2 as the guide describes it.

A lies on dark reddish-brown wood, the darker, redder wood the generated computer cards used in place of the real light desk. B's racket and ball lie on flat green court with one white line, and the ball is a valid partner object.
pairs.fix: Zip bag with the ring lying on a light, warm wooden tabletop with soft grain, seen from above.

pattern: Generated cards add scenery or decoration that the real cards don't have: ivy, stage trusses, houses and bushes, an island base. They frame the whole object instead of letting the card edge cut it. They light the centre of ray backdrops with a bright glow, set the floor in a different color from the wall with a hard horizon, and swap the real light wood for darker, redder or streaky grain.
